=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:330-360 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `extract_last_json_with_key` only strips fenced JSON when the first and last lines are fences, so prose-around-fence LLM responses can bypass extraction and fall back to generic issue creation.
  WHY: All reviewers identified the same brittle fence-detection root cause in this function; severity is the highest stated among the reviews and confidence is the highest stated.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:159-161 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `TRACKING_ISSUE_NUM` falls back to `ISSUE_NUMBER` without an explicit guard that `ISSUE_NUMBER` is set, so missing workflow input can produce malformed tracking metadata.
  WHY: The reviewers agree on the same missing-default concern for this variable; severity is taken as the highest stated and confidence as the highest stated.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:478-481 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: PR-number sanitization is implemented inconsistently across the review scripts, with one path copying to `SAFE_PR_NUMBER` and another mutating `PR_NUMBER` in place.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers reported the same cross-script inconsistency; the disagreement is only about maintainability impact, so the highest stated severity/confidence are kept.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:224-270 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The fix-up creation loop keeps trying later issue creations even after `creation_failed` is set, leaving a partial batch state after an early failure.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding preserved as required; no cross-review duplicate was reported for this root cause.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:481 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT` is not explicitly exported as `false` at the point the reviewer flagged, so downstream logic may rely on implicit defaults.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding preserved as required; later reviewers disputed this as non-buggy, so the original finding remains unchanged in the consensus ledger.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:335-341 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `extract_last_json_with_key` has brittle fence detection logic that only strips code fences when they appear on the first and last lines, so prose around a fenced JSON block can prevent extraction.
  WHY: The function’s current fence check does not handle empty lines, surrounding prose, or multiple fence blocks, which can make the diagnose step fall back to a generic error issue instead of using the specific diagnosis.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:478-480 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `PR_NUMBER` sanitization is handled differently in `review_commit_changes.sh` than in `review_issue_ledger.sh`, which could confuse maintainers.
  WHY: The reviewer flagged the inconsistent sanitization pattern as a code-consistency issue rather than a runtime failure.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT` variable lifecycle could be better documented.
  WHY: The reviewer explicitly characterized this as a documentation gap and low-priority hardening concern.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:330-360 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `extract_last_json_with_key` uses a brittle first/last-line fence check that fails when the LLM includes prose outside a JSON code block.
  WHY: The fallback `raw_decode` path can still mis-handle multiple objects or trailing prose, so the extraction logic remains unreliable for common response shapes.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:161 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `TRACKING_ISSUE_NUM` has no fallback to a known safe value if the issue-body regex fails to match, beyond `ISSUE_NUMBER`.
  WHY: If the issue body lacks the tracking marker, the created fix-up issues can point to a tracking issue that is actually the task issue, confusing orchestrator state management.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:478-480 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `SAFE_PR_NUMBER` sanitization is performed in `review_commit_changes.sh` while `review_issue_ledger.sh` sanitizes separately, creating a path/logic drift risk.
  WHY: The reviewer flagged the duplicated sanitization logic as a potential source of divergence between the writer and detector paths.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:224-270 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fix-up creation loop continues after `creation_failed=1`, so later items are still attempted after a partial failure.
  WHY: This can leave the project in an inconsistent partial state where some follow-up tasks exist and others are lost.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:481 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT` should be explicitly exported as `false` when no commit is made.
  WHY: The reviewer suggested initializing the environment variable at the start of the script as a hardening measure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/issue_ledger/issue_ledger/issue_ledger/issue_ledger/issue_ledger.ash:330-360 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `extract_last_json_with_key` only extracts fenced JSON when both the first and last lines are fences, so prose-prefixed responses can bypass the intended cleanup and break parsing.
  WHY: The function falls back to the raw text when the outer fence check fails, which can cause the generic fallback issue to be created instead of the specific diagnosis.
- scripts/issue_ledger/issue_ledger/issue_ledger.working_issue_ledger and scripts/issue_ledger/issue_ledger/issue_ledger/issue_ledger/issue_ledger/commit_changes.working_issue_ledger:review_issue_ledger.ash 678-680, review_issue_ledger/commit_changes.ash 478-481 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: PR-number sanitization is done inconsistently between the two scripts, using an in-place mutation in one and a copied `SAFE_PR_UMBER` variable in the other.
  WHY: Both scripts still produce safe paths, but the differing approach and variable naming create maintainability and consistency concerns.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:330-360 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `extract_last_json_with_key` can miss valid JSON when the response includes prose before a fenced code block, because the fence check assumes the first line starts with backticks.
  WHY: The function’s recovery path may still succeed, but the brittle first-line assumption makes the extraction less reliable and can fall back to generic issue creation.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh: lines 489-494 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT` may be unset when the commit step is skipped.
  WHY: The reviewer noted this as an implicit-undefined behavior concern, though they also stated GitHub Actions treats it as empty string and the existing defaults mitigate it.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:159-161 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `TRACKING_ISSUE_NUM` can become empty if both the body marker is missing and `ISSUE_NUMBER` is unset.
  WHY: The created fix-up issue body would then contain `Tracking issue: #`, which is incomplete tracking metadata.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:335-339,341-353 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `extract_last_json_with_key` regressed from robust regex-based fence stripping to a brittle first/last-line heuristic, so prose around fenced JSON can prevent extraction.
  WHY: The reviewer states the new heuristic can force fallback to a generic fix-up issue and that the previous regex-based approach handled these cases more reliably.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:159-161 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `TRACKING_ISSUE_NUM` lacks an explicit guard that `ISSUE_NUMBER` is set before it is used in fix-up metadata.
  WHY: If both extraction and environment provisioning fail, the tracking metadata becomes malformed, though the reviewer rates this as a low-severity defensive gap.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:478-481, scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:679-681 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: PR-number sanitization is implemented inconsistently between the two scripts, one using `SAFE_PR_NUMBER` and the other mutating `PR_NUMBER` in place.
  WHY: The reviewer frames this as a maintainability issue that does not currently cause a runtime bug.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
